proximity

  • CURIE: gmeow:proximity
  • IRI: https://blackcatinformatics.ca/gmeow/proximity
  • Category: property
  • Defined by: gmeow:slices/places

Links an entity to a proximity measurement describing its distance or dissimilarity to another entity. The measurement carries the scalar value (via observationResult → ScalarQuantity), the reference frame (via hasReferenceFrame), and the target entity (via proximityTo). Flat form for the common case; promote to full reified Measurement when vantage, confidence, temporal scope, or standpoint matter.

Structure

Property shape: object property; gmeow:Entity -> gmeow:ProximityMeasurement

Practical Pattern

Use gmeow:proximity from gmeow:Entity to gmeow:ProximityMeasurement when the relationship itself belongs in the native GMEOW graph.

gmeow:Entity, gmeow:ProximityMeasurement
